content:
There are 6 houses, numbered 1 to 6 from left to right, as seen from across the street. Each house is occupied by a different person. Each house has a unique attribute for each of the following characteristics:
 - Each person has a unique name: `Arnold`, `Carol`, `Peter`, `Eric`, `Bob`, `Alice`
 - Each person lives in a unique style of house: `ranch`, `colonial`, `modern`, `craftsman`, `mediterranean`, `victorian`
 - Everyone has something unique for lunch: `pizza`, `stew`, `spaghetti`, `grilled cheese`, `stir fry`, `soup`
 - Each person prefers a unique type of vacation: `cultural`, `cruise`, `mountain`, `camping`, `city`, `beach`
 - People have unique heights: `average`, `very tall`, `very short`, `short`, `tall`, `super tall`
 - Everyone has a unique favorite cigar: `yellow monster`, `prince`, `dunhill`, `pall mall`, `blue master`, `blends`

## Clues:
1. Alice is in the fifth house.
2. The person who loves stir fry is the person living in a colonial-style house.
3. Alice is the person who loves the spaghetti eater.
4. Arnold is the person who loves the stew.
5. There is one house between the person who has an average height and Peter.
6. The person in a Craftsman-style house is not in the third house.
7. The person who has an average height is the person who loves stir fry.
8. The person who loves beach vacations is the person in a ranch-style home.
9. Eric is in the fourth house.
10. There is one house between the person living in a colonial-style house and the person who enjoys camping trips.
11. The person who enjoys mountain retreats is the person who smokes Yellow Monster.
12. The person who enjoys mountain retreats is the person who is very tall.
13. The person who enjoys mountain retreats and the Dunhill smoker are next to each other.
14. The person who loves the spaghetti eater is the person residing in a Victorian house.
15. The person who is tall is the person who loves beach vacations.
16. The person who is tall is somewhere to the left of the person residing in a Victorian house.
17. The person who loves stir fry is directly left of Bob.
18. The person in a modern-style house is somewhere to the left of Alice.
19. The person in a Craftsman-style house is somewhere to the left of the person who is short.
20. The person who loves stir fry is somewhere to the left of the Prince smoker.
21. There are two houses between the person who loves eating grilled cheese and the person who is super tall.
22. The person in a ranch-style home is the person who smokes Blue Master.
23. The person who smokes many unique blends is directly left of the person who smokes Blue Master.
24. The person who goes on cultural tours is the person who is a pizza lover.
25. The person who is a pizza lover is somewhere to the left of the person who likes going on cruises.


Please output the solution in the following JSON format:
{"solution": {"header": ["House", "Name", "HouseStyle", "Food", "Vacation", "Height", "Cigar"], "rows": [["1", "Value1", "Value2", ...], ["2", "Value1", "Value2", ...]]}}

We can show that by “cross‐checking” all of the puzzle’s constraints the unique solution is as follows:

• In house 1 (the very‐first house) Carol lives in a colonial–style home; she eats stir fry (and because “stir fry” comes with “average” height, she is average–height) and her cigar is “Pall Mall”. Her vacation is “city.”

• In house 2 Bob’s home is done in a Craftsman style. He enjoys pizza – and by rule 24 (cultural tourist equals pizza eater) his vacation is “cultural”. (Also, by rule 20 the pizza–lover is to the right of the stir–fry eater.) Bob is “very short” (one of the three leftover heights) and he smokes “Prince.”

• In house 3 Peter (by rule 5 the person with ‘average’ in house 1 and Peter in house 3 have one house between) lives in a modern–style home. He eats grilled cheese and is on “camping” trips. He turns out to be “short” and he smokes “blends” – which (by rule 23) is immediately to the left of the Blue Master smoker.

• In house 4 Eric (by rule 9) resides in a ranch–style home (because the person who loves beach vacations lives in a ranch–style home, rule 8) that is part of the “tall” cluster. In fact, Eric is tall, takes beach vacations and smokes Blue Master (and by rule 23 the person immediately to his left smokes blends).

• In house 5 Alice (by rule 1 and rule 14 the spaghetti eater lives in the Victorian house) lives in a Victorian–style home. In our solution her food is spaghetti. Moreover, by one of the “mountain–retreat” links (rules 11–12) the mountain–lover must be very tall and smoke Yellow Monster; thus Alice’s vacation is “mountain”, her height is “very tall” and her cigar is “Yellow Monster.” (Also, by rule 16 the “tall” person is somewhere to the left of the Victorian house.)

• In house 6 Arnold (by rule 4 he eats stew) lives in a Mediterranean–style home (the only remaining style). By rule 25 the pizza–lover (in house 2) is to the left of the cruise–lover; here Arnold’s vacation is “cruise.” Also, by rule 13 (the mountain–lover and the Dunhill–smoker are next to each other) and since house 5 already has Yellow Monster, Arnold must smoke Dunhill. Finally, the only remaining height (after “average”, “tall” and “very tall” are already used and once “short” and “very short” have been allotted to houses 3 and 2, respectively) is “super tall” so Arnold is super tall.

One may check that every single clue is met with these assignments. (For example, rule 17 says the stir–fry lover is immediately to the left of Bob – indeed Carol in house 1 has stir fry and Bob is in house 2; rule 21 says that exactly two houses separate the grilled cheese lover and the super tall person – Peter (in house 3) eats grilled cheese and Arnold (in house 6) is super tall; and so on.)

The final answer in the required JSON format is shown below.

  "solution": {
    "header": ["House", "Name", "HouseStyle", "Food", "Vacation", "Height", "Cigar"],
    "rows": [
      ["1", "Carol", "colonial", "stir fry", "city", "average", "Pall Mall"],
      ["2", "Bob", "craftsman", "pizza", "cultural", "very short", "Prince"],
      ["3", "Peter", "modern", "grilled cheese", "camping", "short", "blends"],
      ["4", "Eric", "ranch", "soup", "beach", "tall", "Blue Master"],
      ["5", "Alice", "Victorian", "spaghetti", "mountain", "very tall", "Yellow Monster"],
      ["6", "Arnold", "mediterranean", "stew", "cruise", "super tall", "Dunhill"]
    ]
  }
}

----------------------------------

This is the unique solution that satisfies all twenty–five clues.
